events.name: Encinitas Holiday Parade 2016
events.summary: ESA’s founding year, and the first Encinitas Holiday Parade night in the Photos library. Parade night is confirmed from the pictures, though ESA itself is not clearly visible in this set.
events.body: Saturday, December 3, 2016, is ESA’s founding-year parade night — the first Encinitas Holiday Parade in the association’s photo albums. The pictures confirm a holiday-parade evening on Coast Highway, with lit floats and a crowd in the street. ESA itself is not clearly visible in these 18 shots, so they read as the night the search started rather than a formal float portrait.
highlights: Parade night confirmed from the photos
ESA is not clearly visible in this album
notes: The Photos album holds 18 items (2 videos, not shown). ESA is not clearly visible in the stills.

events.name: Encinitas Holiday Parade 2017
events.subhead: The sign goes on the truck
events.summary: Float staging for the 2017 Encinitas Holiday Parade, with the Encinitas Sasquatch Association sign on the truck and a sunset over the coast before the roll-out.
events.body: On Saturday, December 2, 2017, ESA staged the float for the Encinitas Holiday Parade. The album is a short, clear one: the association’s banner on the truck, a little pre-parade setup, and that late-afternoon Encinitas light over the palisades. This is the first year the Photos library shows the ESA sign in the frame.
highlights: Float staging with the ESA sign

events.name: Encinitas Holiday Parade 2018
events.summary: The city’s theme was Botanical Oasis. ESA’s story: El Squatcho and a roost of monarchs heading south to Mexico, stopping by Encinitas on the way.
events.body: On Saturday, December 1, 2018, the Encinitas Holiday Parade celebrated Botanical Oasis — the flora and fauna of the city by the sea. ESA’s version of that story was El Squatcho (aka Bigfoot) traveling with a roost of monarchs on their migration to Mexico, a stopover in Encinitas before the warm winter grounds. (An older recap story was dated December 10; the parade itself, and the Photos album, are December 1.)
highlights: El Squatcho and a roost of monarchs heading south
notes: An earlier timeline used December 10, 2018, which is the recap story’s date. ESA-Events.md and the Photos album confirm Saturday, December 1.

events.name: School visit and sign night 2019
events.subhead: A classroom, a sign, a parade tomorrow
events.summary: The day before the 2019 parade: a classroom Bigfoot talk and sign prep. The album covers the morning and midday; some evening shots from that day were left out of the window.
events.body: On Friday, December 6, 2019, ESA did a school visit — a Bigfoot talk in the classroom — and started getting signs ready for the next night’s parade. The Photos album runs from 6:47 AM to 12:45 PM. Fourteen evening shots from that same day are not in the album; they may be the sign night itself, and they have not been reviewed into the set.
highlights: Classroom presentation and sign prep for the 2019 parade
notes: 14 evening shots from that day are not in the album (possibly the sign night). They were outside the time window and have not been reviewed.
sources: Photos album: ESA School Visit and Sign Night 2019
events.album: ESA School Visit and Sign Night 2019

events.name: Encinitas Holiday Parade 2019
events.summary: Theme: Encinitas On the Move! Nessie joined the crew. ESA took 1st place for Most Spirit and 2nd for Most Unusual.
events.body: On Saturday, December 7, 2019, the Encinitas Sasquatch Association rolled in the Encinitas Holiday Parade under the theme “Encinitas On the Move!” — a celebration of how this town gets around. Bigfoot’s good pal Nessie joined the crew, and ESA came home with 1st place for Most Spirit and 2nd place for Most Unusual. If you look closely this time of year, you can still find migrating sasquatches enjoying the sun, sand, and surf.

events.name: Holiday Parade 2020, COVID edition
events.summary: A socially distanced stroll through Encinitas Ranch instead of the usual parade route. The exact date is still unresolved; the Photos album is a backyard BELIEVE-sign set from the evening of Friday, December 11.
events.body: In December 2020, the Encinitas Sasquatch Association spread holiday joy with a socially distanced stroll through Encinitas Ranch — a chance to meet neighbors, smile, and keep the tradition going when the usual parade couldn’t. The exact date is still an open question: a recap was dated December 5, the Photos album is a backyard set with the lit BELIEVE sign on Friday, December 11, and a calendar screenshot mentions December 18. Nothing clearly ESA appears in Photos on the 5th or the 18th. Until that is settled, we list this one as December 2020.
highlights: Socially distanced stroll through Encinitas Ranch
notes: Three sources disagree on the date: a recap dated Dec 5; Photos of the backyard BELIEVE set on Fri Dec 11, 7:57–8:21 PM; a calendar alert in a screenshot reading “Big Foot Parade, December 18, 2020, 18:00.” Nothing ESA is in Photos on Dec 5 or Dec 18. The best 2020 material (lit trucks, masked crew with BELIEVE signs) is in the group chat, not in Photos.

events.name: Parade prep and sign-making 2021
events.summary: The night before the return to Coast Highway: “Squatch Saves Parade” signs, paint, and prep for Saturday’s roll-out.
events.body: On Friday, December 3, 2021, ESA spent the evening making signs — including “Squatch Saves Parade” — getting ready to return to the Encinitas Holiday Parade the next night. After a year of a socially distanced stroll, the crew was prepping to be back on Coast Highway 101.
highlights: Friday, December 3, 2021, the night before the parade

events.name: Encinitas Holiday Parade 2021
events.summary: ESA returned to Coast Hwy 101 at 5:30 PM after the 2020 stroll. Clips with the ESA banner were shot 5:49 to 6:06 PM on Saturday, December 4 — settling an earlier Dec 4-or-5 question.
events.body: On Saturday, December 4, 2021, at 5:30 PM, the Encinitas Sasquatch Association came back to the streets of Encinitas. After the 2020 stroll, Bigfoot’s favorite stopover on the migration south was a proper parade again. An earlier record had left the date as “Dec 4 or 5”; clips with the ESA banner were shot 5:49 to 6:06 PM on December 4, so that is the night we use. Thanks to everyone who stayed safe and came back out — and to the doctors, nurses, EMTs, and front-line workers who helped open Encinitas back up. We are better together.
highlights: Return to Coast Hwy 101 after the 2020 stroll
notes: An earlier timeline left the date as Dec 4 or 5. ESA-Events.md confirms Saturday, December 4 from clips with the ESA banner shot 5:49–6:06 PM.

events.name: San Diego Pride 2022
events.location: San Diego Pride Parade, San Diego
events.summary: ESA’s first Pride. A float celebrating love and kindness, built as a surprise for co-founder Allison Palmer’s 50th birthday.
events.body: Saturday, July 16, 2022, was ESA’s first San Diego Pride. Bigfoot loves everyone, and there is no better place to say so than this parade. The float was built as a surprise for co-founder Allison Palmer’s 50th birthday — a rolling thank-you for love and kindness, and for everyone who came out.
highlights: Surprise 50th birthday float for co-founder Allison Palmer

events.name: Encinitas Holiday Parade 2022
events.summary: 5:30 PM on Coast Hwy 101. The city’s theme was Classic Encinitas; ESA saluted the lima bean — Live. Laugh. Love. Lima.
events.body: On Saturday, December 3, 2022, at 5:30 PM, ESA rolled down Coast Highway 101 under Classic Encinitas and paid tribute to the lima bean, a crop of Encinitas settlers from long ago. Some believe it is the sun, the surf, and the people that lure Bigfoot here. ESA believes it is the scent of a fresh pot of lima beans. Farmer attire preferred; squatch hunter if that’s all you’ve got.
highlights: Theme: Classic Encinitas and the lima bean

events.name: 1st Annual Bigfoot Bash Beach Cleanup
events.location: Beacons Beach, Encinitas, then Duck Foot Tasting Room
events.summary: Cleanup Sunday, August 27, 10 AM at Beacons Beach, then Duck Foot. Saturday the 26th was raffle prep. Moved from August 20 by the hurricane. Hats and a raffle raised $300 for United Way Maui Wildfire Relief.
events.body: The 1st Annual Bigfoot Beach Bash was moved from August 20 by the hurricane and landed on the weekend of August 26–27, 2023. Saturday was raffle prep. Sunday at 10 AM the crew cleaned Beacons Beach, then headed to the Duck Foot Tasting Room for beers, Haggo’s Tacos, and friends. Hats and a raffle with prizes from Corner Pizza, Haggo’s, and Coco Pots raised $300 for United Way Maui Wildfire Relief. Thanks to Home Depot Encinitas for the buckets.
highlights: Beacons Beach Sunday, August 27, 2023, 10 AM, then Duck Foot
Moved from August 20 by the hurricane
$300 raised for United Way Maui Wildfire Relief
sources: Airtable Stories, “1st Annual Bigfoot Bash Beach Cleanup”

events.name: Encinitas Holiday Parade 2023
events.summary: 5:00 to 7:30 PM at spot 40. The city’s theme was Traditions of Encinitas; ESA’s story was the little oaks. Post-party at Duck Foot.
events.body: On Saturday, December 2, 2023, from 5:00 to 7:30 PM, ESA rolled from spot 40 under the theme Traditions of Encinitas. Bigfoot loves trees, especially oak trees — some say that’s why he explored Encinitas in the first place. After the route, the crew landed at Duck Foot. Happy Holidays Encinitas.
highlights: Theme: Traditions of Encinitas; ESA story: the little oaks

events.name: Care Fair 2024
events.summary: An ESA tent at the Care Fair in San Elijo Hills Community Park — hats, smiles, and “I party with Bigfoot.” This one was not on the older public timeline.
events.body: On Sunday, March 10, 2024, ESA set up a tent at the Care Fair in San Elijo Hills Community Park. The album is hats, the booth, and “I party with Bigfoot” — a daytime gathering, not a parade, and one that had not made it onto the earlier public timeline page.
highlights: ESA tent, hats, and “I party with Bigfoot”
Sunday, March 10, 2024, San Elijo Hills Community Park
notes: Not on the earlier public timeline page.

events.name: San Diego Pride 2024
events.location: San Diego Pride Parade, San Diego (spot 252, blue staging area)
events.summary: ESA’s second Pride. 10 AM step-off from the blue staging area, spot 252, leaving footprints of love and kindness.
events.body: Saturday, July 20, 2024, was ESA’s second San Diego Pride. Step-off was 10 AM from the blue staging area at spot 252, under the parade’s “Making History Now” theme. Bigfoot leaves footprints of love and kindness for everyone — and this year the association showed up to walk that message with friends.
highlights: 10:00 AM step-off, blue staging area, spot 252
sources: Airtable Events, “2024 San Diego Pride Parade”

events.name: 2nd Annual Bigfoot Beach Bash
events.location: Beacons Beach, Leucadia, then Duck Foot Tasting Room
events.summary: Second year in a row: 10 AM at Beacons Beach with Duck Foot, then an after-party at the tasting room from noon to 3 PM.
events.body: On Sunday, September 1, 2024, the Encinitas Sasquatch Association teamed up with Duck Foot again to clean Beacons Beach in Leucadia, starting at 10 AM. After the rakes and buckets, the after-party ran at Duck Foot from noon to 3 PM. Bigfoot loves Encinitas. Bigfoot also loves a clean beach.
highlights: 10 AM at Beacons Beach, then Duck Foot
Second year of the Beach Bash
sources: Airtable Events, “2nd Annual Bigfoot Beach Beach Bash”

events.name: Encinitas Holiday Parade 2024
events.location: Coast Hwy 101, Encinitas (spot 85, Red Zone near 2nd and G)
events.summary: 5:30 PM at spot 85, Red Zone near 2nd and G. The city’s theme was Creativity in Motion; ESA went quantum and cosmic. This is the thinnest parade album — only 10 of that day’s 55 items.
events.body: On Saturday, December 7, 2024, at 5:30 PM, ESA lined up at spot 85 in the Red Zone near 2nd and G. The city’s theme was Creativity in Motion; ESA invited Encinitas to get quantum and shine in a cosmic state, with Bigfoot as a visitor among friends. This album is the thinnest parade set in the library: only 10 of that day’s 55 items made the time window, so the gallery is short on purpose.
highlights: Theme: Creativity in Motion / Get Quantum
Spot 85, Red Zone near 2nd and G, 5:30 PM
notes: Thinnest album: only 10 of that day’s 55 items (5 of them videos). 45 shots from the same day were left outside the window and have not been reviewed into the album.

events.name: Let's Help LA: fire relief at Duck Foot
events.summary: From 5 PM at Duck Foot in Leucadia: a supply and fund drive, $1 per pint and all bingo donations to LA fire victims, with the ESA banner, a donation pile, and bingo.
events.body: On Wednesday, January 15, 2025, starting at 5 PM, ESA gathered at Duck Foot in Leucadia for Let’s Help LA — a supply and fund drive for fire victims. A dollar from each pint and all bingo donations went to relief. The album is the ESA banner, the donation pile, and a room full of people showing up for neighbors.
highlights: Wednesday, January 15, 2025, from 5 PM at Duck Foot, Leucadia
$1 per pint and all bingo donations to LA fire victims
sources: Email review of the January 15, 2025 gathering
Photos album: ESA LA Fire Relief 2025

events.name: San Diego Pride 2025
events.location: San Diego Pride Parade, San Diego
events.summary: ESA’s third Pride: the association’s banner and a Jeep, Saturday, July 19, 2025. This one had been missing from the older public timeline.
events.body: On Saturday, July 19, 2025, the Encinitas Sasquatch Association went to San Diego Pride for a third time. The Photos album — the largest event set in the library — shows the ESA banner and a Jeep among the day’s footprints of love and kindness. This Pride had not yet been added to the older public timeline page.
notes: Missing from the earlier public timeline page. Largest album in the ESA folder (209 items, 28 of them videos).

events.name: Encinitas Holiday Parade 2025
events.location: Coast Hwy 101, Encinitas (spot 43, green corner of 2nd and F)
events.subhead: A favorite stop on the migration south
events.summary: Back on Coast Hwy 101 from 5:30 to 8:30 PM at spot 43, the green corner of 2nd and F.
events.body: On Saturday, December 6, 2025, the Encinitas Sasquatch Association was back on Coast Highway 101 from 5:30 to 8:30 PM, at spot 43 — the green corner of 2nd and F. Another holiday night of floats, friends, and Bigfoot’s favorite stop on the migration south. This is one of the largest parade albums in the library.
highlights: Spot 43, green corner of 2nd and F
notes: 87 morning shots from that day (8:19–11:28 AM) were left outside the window and have not been reviewed into the album.
sources: Email review: Saturday, December 6, 2025, 5:30–8:30 PM, spot 43

events.name: ESA / Duck Foot Beach Cleanup 2026
events.location: Beacons Beach, Encinitas, then Duck Foot Tasting Room, Leucadia
events.subhead: Sunscreen, buckets, and a clean beach
events.summary: 10:30 AM at Beacons Beach with Duck Foot, Sun Bum, and Un Mar de Colores, then an after-party at Duck Foot Leucadia.
events.body: On Sunday, June 28, 2026, at 10:30 AM, ESA returned to Beacons Beach with Duck Foot, Sun Bum, and Un Mar de Colores for another beach cleanup, then headed to Duck Foot in Leucadia. Sunscreen, water, a beach hat, and a willingness to keep Encinitas inviting for magical creatures big and small — still the official packing list.
highlights: With Duck Foot, Sun Bum, and Un Mar de Colores
sources: Email review of the June 28, 2026 cleanup

events.name: 10th Encinitas Holiday Parade
events.summary: ESA’s 10th Encinitas Holiday Parade is Saturday, December 5, 2026, at 5:30 PM on Coast Hwy 101. The theme is 40 & Fabulous. Staging spot to be announced; photos will land here once they’re in the library.
events.body: On Saturday, December 5, 2026, at 5:30 PM, the Encinitas Sasquatch Association rolls down Coast Highway 101 for its 10th Encinitas Holiday Parade. The theme is 40 & Fabulous — a night to celebrate Encinitas, a decade of holiday migrations, and whoever might be watching from the trees. The staging spot is still to be announced, and the Photos album has not been created yet. Want to ride, walk, wrangle giveaways, or cheer from the curb? RSVP and we’ll find you a spot.
notes: No Photos album yet — upcoming. Pride 2026 (July 18) is omitted: ESA did not participate; registration was denied on July 6. Pride 2023 is also omitted: there is no sign ESA took part.
sources: Email review and Paper campaign boards: theme 40 & Fabulous
